# From G7’s Vision on AI Openness to EU’s Tech Sovereignty Package

- [Nick Vidal](https://opensource.org/blog/author/nvidal)

“What do you think the first three months on the job will look like?”

If you had asked me this question in April, I might have listed a hundred observations about community meetings, operations, fundraising, messaging, or strategy. Nowhere in that list would I have said “I expect to be invited to address the G7 Digital and Technology Ministers.”  But thanks to the excellent work of our policy staff, that’s exactly what happened. If you look at the G7’s Vision on AI Openness or the European Union’s Tech Sovereignty Package, you can see where the OSI has been working to advocate for mindful inclusion of Open Source principles.

The policy landscape continues to evolve and mature with regards to Open Source – funding it, securing it, legislating it. I’m incredibly proud of our policy team and their ability to stay on top of these changes. When legislators propose new policies that impact the Open Source ecosystem, it is vital that we help them understand the benefits of Open Source, how it works, and the freedoms, trust, and innovation that it enables, so they produce policies and legislation that support and protect Open Source for all of us.

This year’s [UN Open Source Week](https://www.unopensource.org/) runs from June 22-26. It’s a week packed with talks, workshops, meetings, and ancillary events of all kinds. I will be attending the event with support from some of our staff and board members, and we’re excited to connect with community members from around the world. If you’re in town for the event, and you want to try and set up a meeting with myself or OSI staff, [fill out a meeting request form](https://opensource.org/events/un-open-source-week-2026). We can’t promise we’ll be able to take every meeting, but we’ll do our best to meet as many folks as we can. If you’re not going to be in town for the event, you can always [grab a slot in my office hours](https://calendar.app.google/6hRkYLFo8tKC2GFo9).

## News from the OSI

### [OSI welcomes the European Union’s “Tech Sovereignty” package](https://opensource.org/blog/osi-welcomes-the-european-unions-tech-sovereignty-package)

The European Union (EU) published its “Tech Sovereignty” package, with a vision that puts Open Source at the heart of the EU’s digital sovereignty ambitions, while addressing many concerns and requests of Open Source communities.

### [Open Source Initiative Helps G7 Deliver Vision On AI Openness](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-initiative-helps-g7-deliver-vision-on-ai-openness)

On May 29, 2026 in Paris, G7 Digital and Technology ministers approved a “Vision on AI openness opportunities and shared language”. The vision, which sets out terminology around AI openness, is the result of a three-month partnership between the OSI and the G7.

### [Open Source Organizations Weigh in on Age Attestation](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-organizations-weigh-in-on-age-attestation)

The Open Source Initiative (OSI), Apereo Foundation, Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF), FreeBSD Foundation, and Open Source Technology Improvement Fund (OSTIF) issued the following statement on age attestation requirements for operating systems.

### OSI in the news

- [Le G7 s’engage pour un numérique responsable : quatre priorités adoptées sous présidence française](https://www.entreprises.gouv.fr/la-dge/actualites/le-g7-sengage-pour-un-numerique-responsable-quatre-priorites-adoptees-sous) (French government)
- [G7 Digital and Technology Ministerial Declaration](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/g7-digital-and-technology-ministerial-declaration-29-may-2026/g7-digital-and-technology-ministerial-declaration-29-may-2026) (UK government)

### Video recordings

- [Building Resilience: The Next Decade of Open Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-7qO37l2YfI) (Berlin Buzzwords, featuring Ruth Suehle)
- [Why age assurance laws matter for developers](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1yXuKjwIYEM) (GitHub, featuring Katie Steen-James)
- [Beyond SBOMs: Making License Data Actionable With ClearlyDefined](https://youtu.be/gUF1kgGmFx4?si=OUKjstQ7Ss56uMBo) (Open Source Summit NA, featuring Jamie Magee)

### News from community members

- [How the EU’s Tech Sovereignty Package Finally Puts Open Source to the Test](https://www.techpolicy.press/how-the-eus-tech-sovereignty-package-finally-puts-open-source-to-the-test/) (Tech Policy Press – Nicholas Gates, Aimilia Givropoulou, Jaakko Karhu)
- [Open Source and the Iceberg Theory](https://spawn-queue.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3799738) (ACM Queue – Alyssa Wright, Stephen Augustus)
- [Co-developing public tools at the European level: lessons learned from two years of collaboration between France, Germany, and the Netherlands](https://interoperable-europe.ec.europa.eu/collection/open-source-observatory-osor/news/how-france-germany-and-netherlands-co-developed-public-tools) (Open Source Observatory – Noemie Kemp)
- [The pressure](https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2026/05/26/the-pressure/) (curl project – Daniel Stenberg)
- [OffOn](https://offon.dev/): Relaunch of a welcoming open source community to learn through hands-on challenges, share knowledge, and build together.

## Events

### Upcoming events

- [UN Open Source Week](https://www.unopensource.org/) (June 22–26 – New York City)

Check the [top 50+ Open Source conferences of 2026](https://opensource.org/blog/top-50-open-source-conferences-in-2026) that the OSI is tracking, including events that intersect with AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and policy.

### CFPs

- [IndiaFOSS](https://fossunited.org/dashboard/cfp/apply/indiafoss/2026) (September 26-27 – Bengaluru)
- [Open Source Summit EU](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/open-source-summit-europe/program/cfp) (October 7-9 – Prague)
- [SeaGL](https://pretalx.seagl.org/2026/cfp) (October 23-24 – Seattle)
- [Open Technology Research Symposium](https://symposium.opentechresearch.org/) (October 26-27 – Barcelona)
- [KubeCon + CloudNativeCon](https://events.linuxfoundation.org/kubecon-cloudnativecon-north-america/co-located-events/cncf-hosted-co-located-events-overview/) (November 9-12 – Salt Lake City)
- [SFSCON](https://www.sfscon.it/call-4-speakers/) (November 13-14 – Bolzano)

### [Open Technology Research Symposium](https://symposium.opentechresearch.org/)

The OSI is pleased to support the inaugural Open Technology Research (OTR) Symposium 2026, taking place on 26–27 October 2026 at the historic University of Barcelona. The [Call for Proposals](https://opensource.org/blog/open-technology-research-symposium-2026-opens-call-for-proposals) is now open through 5 July 2026.

## Thanks to our sponsors

### New sponsors and renewals

- [See all sponsors](https://opensource.org/sponsors)

**Interested in sponsoring, or partnering with, the OSI?** Please see our **[Sponsorship Prospectus](https://opensource.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/OSI_Sponsor_2026.pdf)** and our [Annual Report](https://opensource.org/2024-annual-report). Please [contact the OSI](https://opensource.org/contact-us/)to find out more about how your company can promote open source development, communities and software.

## Support OSI by becoming a full member

Hundreds of individuals and organizations worldwide join as members and support as donors or sponsors of the OSI. They trust in our neutral stewardship of open source licensing and our role in enabling a global community. [Get involved!](https://opensource.org/get-involved)

[OSI welcomes the European Union’s “Tech Sovereignty” package](https://opensource.org/blog/osi-welcomes-the-european-unions-tech-sovereignty-package)

[The OSI 2025 Annual Report Is Now Available](https://opensource.org/blog/the-osi-2025-annual-report-is-now-available)

# 從G7對AI開放願景到歐盟科技主權方案

- [Nick Vidal](https://opensource.org/blog/author/nvidal)

“你認為上任後的前三個月會是什麼樣子？”

如果我在今年四月被問到這個問題，我可能會列出一長串關於社群會議、營運、募資、訊息傳遞或策略的觀察。然而，在這些清單中，我從未想過「預期能受邀與G7數位暨科技部長們對談」。但多虧我們政策團隊的出色工作，這真的發生了。如果你檢視G7的《AI開放願景》或是歐盟的《科技主權方案》，就能看到OSI一直以來努力倡導在推動開放原始碼原則時保持謹慎的方式。

關於開放原始碼的政策環境正在持續發展與成熟化——包括資助、保護以及立法。我對我們政策團隊能夠應對這些變化感到非常自豪。當立法者提出新的政策，且會影響到開放原始碼生態系統時，幫助他們了解開放原始碼的好處、它是如何運作的，以及它所能帶來的自由、信任與創新至關重要。我們的目標是讓他們產出支持並保護所有人的開放原始碼政策與法規。

今年的 [UN Open Source Week](https://www.unopensource.org/) 將於 6 月 22 日至 26 日舉行。這是一個充滿演講、工作坊、會議以及各種附帶活動的一週。我將偕同部分同事與董事會成員一同參加此活動，我們期待能與全球各地社群的參與者聯繫起來。如果你也會出席，並想安排與我或OSI員工見面，請 [填寫會議請求表單](https://opensource.org/events/un-open-source-week-2026)。我們無法保證會答應每個請求，但我們會盡力與更多的人見面。如果你無法親自到場，你也可以 [預約我的辦公時間](https://calendar.app.google/6hRkYLFo8tKC2GFo9)。

## OSI 最新訊息

### [OSI歡迎歐盟「科技主權」方案](https://opensource.org/blog/osi-welcomes-the-european-unions-tech-sovereignty-package)

歐盟（EU）發表了其「科技主權」套件，將開放原始碼置於數位主權雄心中心的願景，同時回應了許多開源社群的關注與需求。

### [開放原始碼倡議協助G7實現人工智慧開放願景](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-initiative-helps-g7-deliver-vision-on-ai-openness)

2026年5月29日，在巴黎舉行的G7數位與科技部長會議上，批准了一項「人工智慧開放機會與共同語言」願景。該願景概述了人工智慧開放的術語框架，是OSI與G7為期三個月合作的成果。

### [開源組織對年齡驗證立場](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-organizations-weigh-in-on-age-attestation)

開放原始碼倡議（OSI）、Apereo基金會、電子隱私與自由聯盟（EFF）、FreeBSD基金會以及開放原始碼技術改進基金（OSTIF）針對作業系統的年齡驗證要求發布了以下聲明。

- [G7承諾負責任數位發展：四大優先事項在法國總統主導下採納](https://www.entreprises.gouv.fr/la-dge/actualites/le-g7-sengage-pour-un-numerique-responsable-quatre-priorites-adoptees-sous)（法國政府）
- [G7數位與科技部長聲明](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/g7-digital-and-technology-ministerial-declaration-29-may-2026/g7-digital-and-technology-ministerial-declaration-29-may-2026)（英國政府）

# 從G7對AI開放願景到歐盟科技主權方案

- [Nick Vidal](https://opensource.org/blog/author/nvidal)

“你認為上任後的前三個月會是什麼樣子？”

如果我在今年四月被問到這個問題，我可能會列出一長串關於社群會議、營運、募資、訊息傳遞或策略的觀察。然而，在這些清單中，我從未想過「預期能受邀與G7數位暨科技部長們對談」。但多虧我們政策團隊的出色工作，這真的發生了。如果你檢視G7的《AI開放願景》或是歐盟的《科技主權方案》，就能看到OSI一直以來努力倡導在推動開放原始碼原則時保持謹慎的方式。

關於開放原始碼的政策環境正在持續發展與成熟化——包括資助、保護以及立法。我對我們政策團隊能夠應對這些變化感到非常自豪。當立法者提出新的政策，且會影響到開放原始碼生態系統時，幫助他們了解開放原始碼的好處、它是如何運作的，以及它所能帶來的自由、信任與創新至關重要。我們的目標是讓他們產出支持並保護所有人的開放原始碼政策與法規。

今年的 [UN Open Source Week](https://www.unopensource.org/) 將於 6 月 22 日至 26 日舉行。這是一個充滿演講、工作坊、會議以及各種附帶活動的一週。我將偕同部分同事與董事會成員一同參加此活動，我們期待能與全球各地社群的參與者聯繫起來。如果你也會出席，並想安排與我或OSI員工見面，請 [填寫會議請求表單](https://opensource.org/events/un-open-source-week-2026)。我們無法保證會答應每個請求，但我們會盡力與更多的人見面。如果你無法親自到場，你也可以 [預約我的辦公時間](https://calendar.app.google/6hRkYLFo8tKC2GFo9)。

## OSI 最新訊息

### [OSI歡迎歐盟「科技主權」方案](https://opensource.org/blog/osi-welcomes-the-european-unions-tech-sovereignty-package)

歐盟（EU）發表了其「科技主權」套件，將開放原始碼置於數位主權雄心中心的願景，同時回應了許多開源社群的關注與需求。

### [開放原始碼倡議協助G7實現人工智慧開放願景](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-initiative-helps-g7-deliver-vision-on-ai-openness)

2026年5月29日，在巴黎舉行的G7數位與科技部長會議上，批准了一項「人工智慧開放機會與共同語言」願景。該願景概述了人工智慧開放的術語框架，是OSI與G7為期三個月合作的成果。

### [開源組織對年齡驗證立場](https://opensource.org/blog/open-source-organizations-weigh-in-on-age-attestation)

開放原始碼倡議（OSI）、Apereo基金會、電子隱私與自由聯盟（EFF）、FreeBSD基金會以及開放原始碼技術改進基金（OSTIF）針對作業系統的年齡驗證要求發布了以下聲明。
